verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own spec page gives the memory type (LPDDR5x) and a headline bandwidth figure of up to 228 GB/s, which covers two of the three sizing inputs. The vendor explicitly does not publish a maximum memory capacity, so developers cannot size against a capacity ceiling from vendor numbers. Missing for 10: published max-memory-capacity figure, bus width or channel detail to corroborate the bandwidth number, independent hands-on bandwidth measurements.
